# Float <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
Float(value)
Float:Float32(value)
```

## Description

Converts a number or a text to a float. Integers are not divided with a fraction (`7 / 2` is 3), so convert one side first.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print 7 / 2
Print Float(7) / 2
Print Float("1.5") + 1
```

```text
3
3.5
2.5
```
